title: The epic says mimid answers VERSION; it answers 421
description:
Epic mimid-1wgh.140 lists VERSION among the 24 Modern verbs mimid answers.
It does not. `Session::command` (crates/mimid-agent-irc/src/command.rs) has
no `"VERSION"` arm, and 351 RPL_VERSION
(~/PROJECT/IETF/specs/ircdocs-modern-numerics.yml) appears nowhere in the
crate; the only VERSION in it is the CTCP comparison inside PRIVMSG
(command.rs:524), which answers a client's `/ctcp mimid VERSION` and not
the IRC verb. A plain `VERSION` gets 421 today, which is the answer the
epic exists to remove.

Found while implementing mimid-1wgh.140.1 (ADMIN, LUSERS, LINKS). Nothing
was changed: the epic's inventory is Mark's, and the fix is either a child
bead for VERSION (351 RPL_VERSION, and Modern's VERSION section at
~/PROJECT/IETF/specs/ircdocs-modern.html:1870-1905, whose <target> and
wildcards raise the same question decision mimid-1wgh.142 settled for
ADMIN) or a corrected count in the epic's description. Mark picks which.

VERSION also carries ISUPPORT: Modern says the command queries "the version
of the software and the RPL_ISUPPORT parameters of the given server", and
the burst's 005 lines already exist in register.rs, so a child bead would
decide whether VERSION repeats them.
